transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Well, I guess the main reason I'm here is because my eating habits have just been completely unpredictable lately. It kind of scared me into making an appointment. Some days I'll just go the whole day and realize I completely forgot to eat anything. And then other times, I'm up past midnight just tearing through takeout and whatever snacks I can find in the house. It's just really all over the place.
When you eat large amounts late at night, do you feel unable to stop or control how much you are eating?

Not really, no. I don't think it's that I can't stop. It's more like... I just finally realize I haven't eaten all day, and I'm starving. So I just eat until I'm full. I don't feel out of control or anything, I'm just making up for lost time, I guess.
Do concerns about your weight or body shape influence when or how much you eat?

No, not really. I mean, I don't think about my weight or anything like that when I'm eating. It's not about trying to be skinny or whatever. I just... I either forget to eat because I'm busy or distracted, or I eat because I'm hungry. It doesn't have anything to do with how I look.
Does this pattern of eating cause you significant distress?

No, I wouldn't say it causes me a lot of distress or anything. It's just... more annoying than anything else. Like, I just wish I had a normal routine instead of being so all over the place with it. But it's not really upsetting me, I just wanted to get it checked out.
How often do you have these late-night episodes of eating?

I'm not really sure, to be honest. It doesn't happen on a set schedule or anything. Just... whenever I get too caught up in things during the day and forget to eat. So I don't really have a specific number for you. It just depends on the week, I guess.
Do you regularly eat most of your daily food after dinner or late in the evening?

No, I wouldn't say it's most of my food, or like a regular everyday thing. Most days I eat pretty normally during the day. It's really just... on those specific days when work gets crazy or I get too distracted to eat earlier. Otherwise, I just eat regular meals at normal times like anyone else.
Do you ever intentionally skip meals or limit how much you eat to control your weight or body shape?

No, I don't do anything like that. I'm not really worried about my weight or trying to change how I look. When I skip meals, it's literally just because I'm busy or distracted, not because I'm trying to diet or control my shape or anything.
Have you experienced significant unintentional weight loss because of this eating pattern?

Not really, I haven't noticed any major weight loss. But honestly, the thing that actually scared me into coming in is just that my eating has been all over the place. Like, some days I forget meals completely, and then other nights I'm just tearing through takeout and snacks after midnight. It's just been really unpredictable lately.
Do you ever make yourself vomit after eating?
No, I don't do that. I've never made myself throw up. Like I said, I'm not trying to lose weight or anything, it's just my schedule and my eating habits being a mess right now.
